response.overview: I’m staying in Sao Paulo for five weeks. There, I meet Tiago, a student and a electroacoustics composer. He intrigues me, I decide to follow him. Together, we go across the city at night, in his car, to reach places that he likes. Between each places, the Minhocão, an elevated road, which cross the city. But Tiago doesn’t want me to film it.
response.title: Minhochaos
